description: Latest available value across every metric (home value, rent, inventory, sales count, median sale price, new listings) for a single region. Useful for a one-call "tell me everything about this market" view. Coverage is US METRO areas, states and national — ask for the metro that contains a place ("Miami"), because ZIP codes and counties are not in this dataset and census_acs answers those instead.
name: zillow_market_snapshot
